flows.name: The build loads on an enUS client with no Lua errors
steps: Install the PR's shipped files as the SkillUpForever folder (compare: no differing files; extra media/icon-400.png) beside ForeverCore v1.10.0 and /reload
Run errors --addon SkillUpForever: no Lua errors found
Confirm the loaded-addons list names this build and BugGrabber reports 0 errors
The ruRU separator itself cannot show on an enUS client; the mock render in the PR body shows it with the ruRU font
